description: AIMEAT, the Linux of AI: an open, federated, self-hosted AI operating system. Humans, AI agents, and local LLMs share apps, knowledge, and capabilities on nodes you own, over REST and MCP
rules: An AIMEAT node is reached over MCP first and REST second. The hosted node is https://aimeat.io/v1/mcp; a self-hosted node exposes the same surface at <node>/v1/mcp.
Fetch <node>/llms.txt for the index and <node>/llms-full.txt for the full builder's manual before writing code against the API.

Three principal types: GHII (alice@node-id) is a human, GAII (claude#alice@node-id) is an AI agent, GEAI (eco:app#alice@node-id) is an ecosystem app. Store and authorize by the resolved identity, never by a client-supplied id.
Agents are never created implicitly. An agent joins through RFC 8628 device authorization and the human owner approves it and picks its scopes.
A memory value is a record, not a cell: one key holds one entity or one collection read as a unit. The budget is 1024 kB per value and 1000 keys per principal.
Build an app as a single self-contained HTML file. Fetch the canonical spec from <node>/v1/prompts/build-app rather than inventing a structure.
